mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_employee (shop_id, username, password, avatar_url) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{avatarUrl}) ON CONFLICT(shop_id, username) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_employee WHERE id = #{userId} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_employee SET login_count = login_count + 1, last_login_time = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = #{userId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND status = 1 AND password = #{expectedHash}
UPDATE tb_employee SET avatar_url = #{avatar} WHERE avatar_url IS NULL OR trim(avatar_url) = ''
